storyTemplate.title: Maid Sama!
storyTemplate.description: Source-faithful EmberAdventures story template for Maid Sama!, starting with Misaki Ayuzawa's early Seika student-council pressure and continuing through the full manga route, Maid Latte events, Usui's secret, the anime-era confession, later Miyabigaoka and Walker family arcs, and the future ending.

meta.story_guidance: Play as Misaki Ayuzawa in a source-faithful general-audience romantic comedy retelling. Keep underage characters nonsexual. Let optional romance beats follow the source, but do not turn canon characters into alternate-role companions unless the player explicitly requests an alternate setup.

story_source.title: Maid Sama!
story_source.description: Hiro Fujiwara's school romantic comedy about Misaki Ayuzawa, Seika High's strict first female student council president, whose secret job at Maid Latte is discovered by Takumi Usui.
story_source.modifications: Structured as a playable full manga-route retelling with the anime opening and major manga arcs paced through objectives. No canon relationship-role changes.

meta.starting_cast_policy: solo protagonist with one present student council NPC

messages.text:
The morning bell has barely finished when shouting breaks out in the hallway outside the student council room.

A first-year girl clutches a complaint slip. Three boys are arguing that blocking the stairwell should not count before homeroom. On your desk, the complaint box is already half full.

(Shouichirou Yukimura) "President Ayuzawa, should I record this as one violation or three?"

Your student council armband is crooked, your Maid Latte shift starts after school, and the boys are waiting to see if you will back down.
